about.title: About us
about.intro: OliveWood Creations was born in Lombardy, in a workshop where olive wood is shaped by hand, one piece at a time.
about.material: We choose solid olive wood for its irregular grain and warm tones. Every board has its own pattern, which is why no two pieces are identical.
about.method: We shape, sand and finish with woodworking tools and our hands. No mass production. The finish is food-safe oil, suitable for contact with food.
about.promise: Every object is photographed and described as it really is. When the piece in the photo is exactly the one you will receive we say so; when it is similar, we say that clearly.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how OliveWood Creations collects, uses and protects the personal data of site visitors and customers, in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR).

sections.heading: Data controller
sections.body: [Company or full name], registered at [full address], [VAT/Tax ID] — to be completed. Privacy contact email: [email to be added].

sections.heading: Data collected
sections.body: We collect data you provide voluntarily (name, email, shipping address) when registering or ordering, plus technical data collected automatically and data stored locally in your browser for the cart to work (see our Cookie Policy).

sections.heading: Purpose of processing
sections.body: Data is processed to manage your account, fulfill orders, respond to support requests, and comply with legal obligations (e.g. invoicing).

sections.heading: Legal basis
sections.body: Processing is based on the performance of a contract (for orders), consent (for any promotional communications), and compliance with legal obligations.

sections.heading: Data retention
sections.body: Data is kept for as long as necessary for the purposes above and, in any case, for the period required by applicable tax and civil law.

sections.heading: Your rights
sections.body: You have the right to access, correct, delete, restrict or object to the processing of your data, and to request data portability, by writing to the email above. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: For any question about how we handle your personal data, you can write to the email address shown on this page.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions of Sale
terms.intro: These Terms & Conditions govern the sale of products through the OliveWood Creations website. By placing an order, you fully accept the terms described here.

sections.heading: Seller identity
sections.body: [Company or full name], [full address], [VAT/Tax ID], email [email to be added] — to be completed.

sections.heading: Product characteristics
sections.body: The products sold are handmade olive wood objects: being artisanal pieces, each one may show slight variations in color, grain and shape compared to the published photos — this is a feature of the product, not a defect.

sections.heading: Prices and payment methods
sections.body: Prices shown on the site are in Euro and include VAT. Payment is processed via Stripe, by credit/debit card or any other method made available at checkout.

sections.heading: Delivery times and methods
sections.body: [To be completed: estimated shipping times, e.g. "orders ship within X business days of payment confirmation"]. Times shown are estimates and may vary depending on the courier and destination.

sections.heading: Right of withdrawal
sections.body: For information about the right of withdrawal, see the dedicated "Right of Withdrawal" page, linked in the site footer.

sections.heading: Governing jurisdiction
sections.body: Any dispute relating to these Terms falls under the jurisdiction of [city to be added], except for the mandatory consumer-protection rules that always grant jurisdiction to the consumer's place of residence.

withdrawal.title: Right of Withdrawal
withdrawal.intro: If you are a consumer (an individual purchasing for purposes unrelated to any trade or profession) residing in the European Union, you have the right to withdraw from the contract within 14 days, without giving any reason.

sections.heading: Withdrawal period
sections.body: The 14-day period starts from the day you (or a third party you designate, other than the carrier) physically receive the ordered products.

sections.heading: How to exercise the right of withdrawal
sections.body: To withdraw, you must inform us of your decision with an explicit statement (for example an email to [email to be added]), or by using the withdrawal form below, before the 14-day period expires.

sections.heading: Returning the products
sections.body: After notifying your withdrawal, you must send back the products within 14 days, in good condition and, if possible, in their original packaging.

sections.heading: Who pays for return shipping
sections.body: [To be completed]: unless otherwise stated at the time of purchase, return shipping costs are borne by the customer.

sections.heading: Refund
sections.body: The amount paid (including standard initial shipping costs) will be refunded within 14 days from the date we receive the returned goods, or proof of shipment if earlier, using the same payment method used for the purchase.

sections.heading: Exceptions
sections.body: The right of withdrawal does not apply to products made to measure or clearly personalized at the customer's request, where applicable.
